title: Figma's AI Tools Test Growth Story As Anthropic Joins The Race
caption: Figma just embedded Claude directly into its design canvas. Anthropic's first major design tool partnership could reshape how 4M+ designers prototype. Here's what changed.

slides.headline: Claude just moved into Figma's canvas
slides.sub: First major design partnership tests if AI can actually speed up creative work

slides.title: The integration is deeper than plugins
slides.body: Claude now lives natively in Figma's editor. Designers can generate component variations, write microcopy, and refactor layouts without leaving the canvas. No API keys, no copy-paste between tabs.
If even 15% use Claude weekly, that's 600,000 design professionals relying on Anthropic's models. Largest creative vertical deal since Adobe's Firefly launch.
